name: Hardin County, Ohio (United States)
description: Green field charged with HARDIN 1833 COUNTY in white within an arc of fifteen white stars for the fifteen townships.
history: Hardin County is a county located in the west central portion of Ohio. The flag was adopted on 4 September 1984 (designed by former county commissioner Stuart Rogers and Rodney K. Rogers, sewn by Delores Warmbrod and first flown on 4 September 1984 at the dedication of the gazebo and flagpoles at the county fairgrounds, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: arc of fifteen stars for the fifteen townships
